questions.question: If the cost price of 4 chairs is equal to selling price of 3 chairs, then the profit or loss percentage is∶
questions.solution:
Let the cost price and selling price of the chair be a and b respectively.

∴ Cost price of four chair = 4a

And the selling price of three chair = 3b

According to the question,

Cost price of four chair = Selling price of three chair

⇒ 4a = 3b

⇒ a/b = 3/4

Profit percentage = (b – a)/a × 100 = (4 – 3)/3 × 100 = 100/3 = 33(1)/(3)\%

questions.question: A bought 38 kg rice @ Rs. 54.50/kg, 45 kg rice @ Rs. 62/kg and 55 kg rice @ Rs. 48/kg. He sold the mixture @ Rs. 65/kg. His profit or loss percentage is∶
questions.solution:
Cost price of 38 kg rice at the rate of Rs. 54.50/kg = 38 × 54.5 = 38 × 109/2 = 19 × 109

= Rs. 2071

Cost price of 45 kg rice at the rate of Rs. 62/kg = 45 × 62 = 90/2 × 62 = 90 × 31 = Rs. 2790

Cost price of 55 kg rice at the rate of Rs. 48/kg = 55 × 48 = 110/2 × 48 = 110 × 24 = Rs. 2640

Total cost price = 2071 + 2790 + 2640 = Rs. 7501

Total quantity of mixture = 38 + 45 + 55 = 138 kg

Selling price of the mixture = Rs. 65/kg

Total selling price = 138 × 65 = Rs. 8970

Profit percentage = (8970 – 7501)/7501 × 100 = 19.58% ≈ 19.6%

questions.question: A can do a work in 12 days and B can do same work in 18 days. After 5 days of working together, how much work will be left?
questions.solution:
Efficiency of A = 1/12

Efficiency of B = 1/18

⇒ Efficiency of A and B together = 1/12 + 1/18 = 5/36

⇒ Work done by A and B together in 5 days = 5 × (5/36) = 25/36

∴ Remaining work = 1 – (25/36) = 11/36

questions.question: One tap can fill a tank in 3 hours and a leak can empty the tank in 5 hours. If the tap and the leak (which was half closed) were left open, how long will it take for the tank to fill?

Since leak was half closed.

∴ Efficiency of the tap when the leak was half closed = 1/3 – 1/10 = 7/30

⇒ Time taken by the tap to fill the tank when the leak was half closed = 1/(7/30) = 30/7 hours = 4(2)/(7) hours

questions.question: The number 45789 is divisible by which of the single digit numbers∶
questions.solution:
Sum of the digits of 45789 is 33.

We know that for a number to be divisible by 3 its sum of digits is also divisible by 3.

Given number is divisible by 3 but not divisible by 9 so option 3 is the answer.

**Divisibility rule for 9** **– **Sum of digits of the number should be divisible by 9.

**Divisibility rule for 7 – **Take the last digit of the number, double it and then subtract it from the remaining number. If the result is divisible by 7, then the original number will also be divisible by 7.
